about: Seed for server/worldEconomy.js. realEstate and wealth are hand-entered anchors (published totals with their URLs; derived: true marks a figure computed from a published growth rate, shown as a checkpoint only). raw holds the last IMF DataMapper and IMF COFER blocks, rewritten by the module when a live fetch brings different data, for machines imf.org refuses.

realEstate.source: Savills World Research, total value of global real estate (residential + commercial + agricultural land), USD at market exchange rates, year-end values

anchors.source: Savills Impacts, 'The total value of global real estate' (Sep 2021)
Savills (25 Sep 2023), 2021 restated in the 2022 release on a revised basis (commercial re-estimated)
Savills (25 Sep 2023), 'Total global value of real estate estimated at $379.7 trillion – almost four times the value of global GDP'
Derived: Savills' start-2025 total ($393.3 tn) was 'down 0.5% year on year'; Savills published no separate 2023 release
Savills (29 Sep 2025), 'World's real estate worth $393.3 trillion and is the world's largest store of wealth' (valued at the start of 2025)

wealth.note: Total net household (personal) wealth, USD at market exchange rates, end of year: Credit Suisse Research Institute Global Wealth Report through the 2023 edition (with UBS), UBS Global Wealth Report since. The 2025 and 2026 editions cover 56 markets estimated at over 92% of world wealth and changed methods, so editions are not strictly comparable. derived: true = computed from the growth rate a later edition reports (no total published in that edition's text).

anchors.source: Credit Suisse Global Wealth Report 2022 (total global wealth +9.8% to $463.6 tn at end-2021)
UBS / Credit Suisse Global Wealth Report 2023 (net private wealth −2.4% to $454.4 tn at end-2022)
Derived: UBS Global Wealth Report 2025 puts 2024 at ~$471 tn after +4.6% in 2024 (471 ÷ 1.046)
UBS Global Wealth Report 2025 ('56 markets, 471 USD trillion in global wealth')
Derived: UBS Global Wealth Report 2026 (30 Jun 2026) reports personal wealth +10.8% in USD in 2025 (471 × 1.108); the report states no total and notes updated methods
